generation: 8 independent edits run in parallel, one image per product
notes: Original source packaging images were inspected first. No external image retouching or cropping performed. Images are for listings, homepage and bundle composition; original bottle-and-box product-detail assets were left unchanged.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution square e-commerce listing photograph, 2048 × 2048 pixels.
Edit the supplied packaging image into a clean BOTTLE-ONLY product image. Keep ONLY the exact BIONIC bottle at the RIGHT of the reference; REMOVE ALL cardboard packaging boxes completely. Center this same complete bottle upright at the center of a square canvas. Bottle height must be 78% of the image height, with 11% clear margin above the cap and 11% below the bottle base. Preserve its actual bottle width-to-height proportions, cap profile, shoulders, label wrap, label layout, logo geometry, front orientation, glass/plastic material and all actual printed wording. Full bottle visible, no crop. Camera nearly straight on at mid-bottle height, very slight top cap visibility like the reference, no dramatic perspective.
Packaging identity: opaque black bottle and smooth black cap; charcoal bp mark and BIONIC word; dark grey vertical biomod. Preserve the white label and all source details. Pin-sharp genuine-looking front label. The original printed front text is exactly: "BIONIC", "RECOVERY + GUT SUPPORT", "DIETARY SUPPLEMENT", "60 SOFTGELS", "BPC-157 ARGINATE + KPV + VITAMIN E". Existing bp symbol and vertical biomod wordmark stay in their original relative positions and designs. Preserve these existing package words, do not add any other claim, ingredient, amount, or line.
Background and light: clean seamless neutral white #ffffff studio background and white matte ground, no visible horizon. Soft neutral studio key light from upper left; faint, short, realistic contact shadow extends gently to the right under the base. Crisp accurate color; no warm or colored cast, no bright glow, no gradients or props. Match a clean professional bottle-only product catalog series.
Change only the image framing, remove boxes, enlarge/reposition the actual bottle and clean the studio setting. Do NOT redesign the package, substitute a different bottle, flatten the logo, add text or change label content. No cartons, boxes, loose capsules, decorative objects, claims, seals, badge, caption, interface, watermark, laboratory setting, or people. One bottle only.
assets.inspection: One bottle only, complete cap and base visible, centered upright. Front label wording and source quantity match on visual inspection; source bottle and cap colors retained. Fine typography and metallic highlights have AI-rendered differences.
